description: Display your key performance indicators with style using the Speedometer KPI Visual - a professional, animated gauge that transforms raw numbers into engaging visual insights. KEY FEATURES: Data Flexibility - Accepts measures, columns, whole numbers, decimals, and percentages - Automatic percentage conversion (0.75 → 75%) - Dynamic min/max override from data fields - Single or multiple data points supported Animated Performance - Smooth needle rotation with customizable speed (100-3000ms) - Enable/disable animation for static reports - Professional transitions on data updates - Eye-catching visual feedback Complete Customization - 20 professional fonts including Segoe UI, Arial, Calibri, Georgia - Full color control: minimum (red), average (yellow), maximum (green) - Gradient or solid color modes - Customizable needle, center circle, background, and target line colors - Adjustable gauge thickness (10-100 pixels) - Line thickness control for clean or bold appearance Target Indicators - Display target line with actual vs. goal comparison - Adjustable line length, thickness, and style (solid/dashed/dotted) - Show target value with customizable formatting - Visual goal tracking Professional Labels - Show/hide: value, target, percentage, min/max - Decimal precision (0-4 places) - Add prefix ($ € £ ₹) and suffix (% K M units) - Font size control (8-72pt) - Custom font color Visual…
